interface.shortDescription: Temporary DEBUG-* FeatureTelemetry probes for inspecting AL runtime behavior.
interface.longDescription: Hypothesis-driven debug logging skill for Business Central AL. Adds temporary DEBUG-* FeatureTelemetry.LogUsage probes to production code, posting routines, validation logic, install/upgrade paths, event subscribers, or tests so an AI agent can inspect runtime behavior in .output/TestResults/telemetry.jsonl. Probes are temporary scaffolding and are removed before final delivery.
